dc_title_s: Aerial Imagery for Douglas County, WI 2025
dc_description_s: This project established digital 3-inch and 6-inch orthoimagery for Douglas County Wisconsin.  The dataset consists of tiled orthogonal imagery produced from nadir images captured by Pictometry International between April 12 and May 3, 2025. 3-inch and 6-inch resolution images are available for download from GeoData@Wisconsin - once downloaded, the resolution can be determined for individual tiles.
